en.s: The Battle of Marj Rahit (Arabic: معركة مرج راهط‎‎, Yawm Mardj Rāhiṭ) was one of the early battles of the Second Islamic Civil War. It was fought on 18 August 684 between the armies of the Yemen, supporting the Umayyads under Caliph Marwan I, and the Banu Qays under al-Dahhak ibn Qays al-Fihri, who supported Abdallah ibn al-Zubayr, who had proclaimed himself Caliph at Mecca. The Kalbi victory consolidated the position of the Umayyads, under Marwan I, over Syria, paving the way for their eventual victory in the civil war against Ibn al-Zubayr.

zh.s: 马尔季·拉希特战役（阿拉伯语：معركة مرج راهط，Yawm Mardj Rāhiṭ）是第二次穆斯林内战初期的战役之一。684年8月18日，支持倭马亚王朝哈里发马尔万一世的也门派系军队，与支持阿卜杜拉·伊本·祖拜尔的盖斯部族交战，盖斯部族由阿尔·达哈克·伊本·盖斯·菲赫里率领。阿卜杜拉·伊本·祖拜尔此前已在麦加自称哈里发。卡尔布部族获胜，巩固了马尔万一世领导下的倭马亚王朝对叙利亚的控制，为其最终在内战中击败伊本·祖拜尔铺平了道路。

en.t: Battle of Marj Rahit: Umayyad partisans defeat the supporters of Ibn al-Zubayr and cement Umayyad control of Syria
en.s: Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr ibn al-Awwam (May 624 – October/November 692) was the leader of a caliphate based in Mecca in opposition to the Umayyads during the Second Fitna from 683 until his death in 692. The son of Zubayr ibn al-Awwam and Asma bint Abi Bakr, and grandson of the first Rashidun caliph Abu Bakr, Ibn al-Zubayr belonged to the Quraysh, the leading tribe of the nascent Muslim community, and was the first child born to the Muhajirun, Islam's earliest converts.

zh.t: 马尔季拉希特战役：倭马亚王朝支持者击败伊本·祖拜尔的拥护者，巩固了倭马亚王朝对叙利亚的控制
zh.s: 阿卜杜拉·伊本·祖拜尔·伊本·阿瓦姆（624年5月—692年10月／11月）是第二次穆斯林内战期间以麦加为基地、反对倭马亚王朝的哈里发政权领袖，执政时间为683年至692年去世。他是祖拜尔·伊本·阿瓦姆和阿斯玛·宾特·阿布·伯克尔之子，也是首任正统哈里发阿布·伯克尔的外孙。伊本·祖拜尔属于古莱氏部落，该部落是新兴穆斯林社群中的主导部族；他也是最早皈依伊斯兰教的迁士中出生的第一个孩子。

en.t: Princess Abe accedes to the imperial Japanese throne as Empress Genmei
en.s: Empress Genmei (元明天皇, Genmei-tennō; April 20, 660 – December 29, 721), also known as Empress Genmyō, was the 43rd monarch of Japan, according to the traditional order of succession. Genmei's reign spanned the years 707 through 715. She established the capital at Heijō-kyō in 710, marking the beginning of the Nara period. In the history of Japan, Genmei was the fourth of eight women to take on the role of empress regnant.

zh.t: 阿倍内亲王即位日本皇位，是为元明天皇
zh.s: 元明天皇（元明天皇，Genmei-tennō；660年4月20日—721年12月29日），也称元明女帝，按传统继承顺序是日本第43代君主。她于707年至715年在位。她于710年将首都设在平城京，开启奈良时代。在日本历史上，元明天皇是八位女天皇中的第四位。

en.s: The Battle of Mons-en-Pévèle was fought on 18 August 1304 between the French and the Flemish. The French were led by King Philip IV "the Fair" in person.

zh.s: 1304年8月18日，法军与佛兰德斯军队爆发蒙桑佩韦勒战役。法军由“美男子”腓力四世国王亲自率领。

en.s: The Battle of Troia was a major battle that took place on 18 August 1462 in the countryside of the Daunia Sub-Apennines, between the cities Orsara and Troia, in the Kingdom of Naples. The clash saw the armies of King Ferrante of Aragon and the pretender to the throne John of Anjou-Valois clash for the throne of Naples. This battle marked a turning point.

zh.s: 1462年8月18日，那不勒斯王国境内的达乌尼亚亚平宁山麓地区，在奥尔萨拉和特罗亚两座城市之间爆发一场重要战役。阿拉贡国王费兰特的军队与王位觊觎者约翰·德·安茹—瓦卢瓦为争夺那不勒斯王位交战。这场战役成为一个转折点。

en.s: The 1487 siege of Málaga was an action during the Reconquest of Spain in which the Catholic Monarchs of Spain conquered the city of Mālaqa from the Emirate of Granada. The siege lasted about four months. It was the first conflict in which ambulances, or dedicated vehicles for the purpose of carrying injured persons, were used.

zh.s: 1487年马拉加围城战是西班牙收复失地运动期间的一场战役。西班牙天主教双王从格拉纳达埃米尔国手中夺取了马拉加城。围城持续约四个月。这是首次使用救护车，也就是专门运送伤员的车辆的战事。

en.s: The Attack on Zuwarah was a military expedition launched by Knights Hospitallers of Malta to sack the Libyan city of Zuwarah. The attack ended in a fiasco for the Maltese knights, who sustained heavy losses.

zh.s: 马耳他医院骑士团发动军事远征，袭击并劫掠利比亚城市祖瓦拉。行动以失败告终，马耳他骑士团损失惨重。

en.t: The Huguenot King Henry III of Navarre marries the Catholic Margaret of Valois, ostensibly to reconcile the feuding Protestants and Catholics of France
en.s: Margaret of Valois (French: Marguerite de Valois; 14 May 1553 – 27 March 1615), popularly known as Queen Margot (La Reine Margot, [la ʁɛn maʁɡo]), was Queen of Navarre from 1572 to 1599 and Queen of France from 1589 to 1599 as the consort of Henry IV of France and III of Navarre.

zh.t: 胡格诺派的纳瓦拉国王亨利三世与天主教徒瓦卢瓦的玛格丽特成婚，表面上旨在调和法国相互敌对的新教徒和天主教徒
zh.s: 瓦卢瓦的玛格丽特（法语：Marguerite de Valois；1553年5月14日—1615年3月27日），广为人知的称号是玛戈王后（La Reine Margot，[la ʁɛn maʁɡo]）。她于1572年至1599年担任纳瓦拉王后，之后于1589年至1599年作为法国国王亨利四世兼纳瓦拉国王亨利三世的王后，担任法国王后。

en.s: The siege of Pskov, known as the Pskov Defense in Russia (Russian: оборона Пскова), took place between August 1581 and February 1582, when the army of the Polish king and Grand Duke of Lithuania Stephen Báthory laid an unsuccessful siege and successful blockade of the city of Pskov during the final stage of the Livonian War of 1558–1583. The first detachments of the Polish–Lithuanian army, which in the previous two years captured Polotsk (1579) and Velikiye Luki (1580), appeared at the walls of Pskov on August 18, 1581.

zh.s: 1581年8月至1582年2月，利沃尼亚战争（1558—1583）末期，波兰国王兼立陶宛大公斯特凡·巴托里率军围攻普斯科夫。波军未能攻下该城，但成功封锁了城市；这场战役在俄罗斯称为“普斯科夫防御”（俄语：оборона Пскова）。此前两年，波兰—立陶宛军队已于1579年攻占波洛茨克，1580年攻占大卢基。1581年8月18日，该军先头部队抵达普斯科夫城墙下。

en.s: The Siege of Hulst of 1596 was a Spanish victory led by Archduke Albert that took place between mid-July and August 18, 1596, at the city of Hulst, Province of Zeeland, Low Countries (present-day the Netherlands), during the Eighty Years' War, the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). After a short siege, during which Maurice of Orange launched a failed attempt to relieve the city – the garrison of Dutch and English troops fell into Spanish hands on August 18, 1596.

zh.s: 八十年战争和英西战争（1585—1604）期间，西班牙军队在阿尔伯特大公率领下取得胡尔斯特围城战的胜利。围城从1596年7月中旬持续至8月18日，地点在低地国家泽兰省胡尔斯特（今属荷兰）。短暂围城期间，奥兰治的莫里斯曾试图解围但未成功；8月18日，荷兰和英国守军落入西班牙军队手中。

en.s: The Battle of Staffarda, 18 August 1690, was fought during Nine Years' War in Piedmont-Savoy, modern-day northern Italy. The engagement was the first major encounter in the Italian theatre since Victor Amadeus, the Duke of Savoy, had joined the Grand Alliance in opposition to France earlier that year. The battle was a clear victory for the French commander, Nicolas Catinat, who proceeded to take other Piedmontese strongholds. The French also overran most of the Duchy of Savoy, but due to sickness, lack of infantry, and problems with supply, Catinat was unable to besiege Amadeus's capital Turin as King Louis XIV had hoped.

zh.s: 1690年8月18日，九年战争期间，皮埃蒙特—萨伏依（今意大利北部）爆发斯塔法尔达战役。此前一年，萨伏依公爵维克托·阿马德奥加入大同盟与法国对抗；这是此后意大利战场上的首场重大战斗。法国指挥官尼古拉·卡蒂纳获胜，随后又攻占皮埃蒙特的其他据点。法军还占领了萨伏依公国的大部分地区，但由于疾病、步兵不足和补给困难，卡蒂纳未能按路易十四国王的期望围攻阿马德奥的首都都灵。

en.s: The sack of Shamakhi took place on 18 August 1721, when rebellious Sunni Lezgins, within the declining Safavid Empire, attacked the capital of Shirvan province, Shamakhi (in present-day Azerbaijan Republic). The initially successful counter-campaign was abandoned by the central government at a critical moment and with the threat then left unchecked, Shamakhi was taken by 15,000 Lezgin tribesmen, its Shia population massacred, and the city ransacked.

zh.s: 1721年8月18日，衰落中的萨法维帝国境内，叛乱的逊尼派列兹金人袭击了希尔凡省首府沙马基（今阿塞拜疆境内）。中央政府在关键时刻放弃了原本进展顺利的反攻，威胁因此未能解除。随后，1.5万名列兹金部族成员攻占沙马基，屠杀当地什叶派居民并劫掠全城。

en.s: Battle of Bodrum (1773), was one of the battles of the Russo-Turkish War (1768–1774). The Russian fleet under the command of Admiral Elmanov landed in Bodrum on 10 August 1773 and in Kos on 17 August, where the Russian troops were repelled by the Turkish garrisons with heavy losses.

zh.s: 博德鲁姆战役（1773年）是1768—1774年俄土战争中的一场战役。埃尔马诺夫海军上将率领的俄罗斯舰队于1773年8月10日在博德鲁姆登陆，8月17日在科斯登陆；俄罗斯军队遭土耳其守军击退，损失惨重。

en.s: The Battle of Fishing Creek, also called the Battle of Catawba Ford, was an American Revolutionary War battle fought on August 18, 1780, between American and British forces including the 71st Foot. It was fought near the junction of Fishing Creek and the Catawba River in South Carolina. British forces under Banastre Tarleton surprised the militia company of Thomas Sumter, killing a significant number, taking about 300 captives, and very nearly capturing Sumter, who some say was asleep at the time of the attack.

zh.s: 1780年8月18日，美国独立战争期间，美英两军在南卡罗来纳州菲欣溪与卡托巴河交汇处附近交战，也称卡托巴浅滩战役。双方包括第71步兵团。班纳斯特·塔尔顿率领的英军突袭了托马斯·萨姆特的民兵连队，造成大量人员伤亡，俘虏约300人，并险些抓获萨姆特；有人说袭击发生时他正在睡觉。

en.s: The raid on Sumatra took place during the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War in August 1781. A fleet of the British East India Company set forth to capture the Dutch settlements on Sumatra including Padang. The raid which was more a bluff, was highly successful and netted much profit for the East India Company; in addition the raid also compelled the Dutch to give trading rights to the British after war.

zh.s: 苏门答腊袭击行动发生于1781年8月的第四次英荷战争期间。英国东印度公司派出舰队，试图夺取苏门答腊岛上的荷兰定居点，包括巴东。这次行动更像是虚张声势，却取得了很大成功，为东印度公司带来丰厚利润；战后还迫使荷兰给予英国贸易权。

en.s: The 1788 election held in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth marked one of the most crucial events in the history of both countries prior to 1795. The elections returned a significant pro-reform camp to the Sejm of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth chosen to repair the Commonwealth's political system and prevent the country from collapsing. The Sejm that emerged as a result of the election has been dubbed the Great Sejm.

zh.t: 1788年波兰立陶宛联邦立法选举
zh.s: 1788年波兰立陶宛联邦举行的选举，是两国1795年前历史上的重要事件之一。选举使一批重要的改革派进入波兰立陶宛联邦议会，他们希望修复联邦的政治制度，阻止国家崩溃。选举产生的议会后来被称为“大议会”。

en.s: The Liège Revolution, sometimes known as the Fortunate Revolution (French: Heureuse Révolution; Walloon: Binamêye revolucion), against the reigning prince-bishop of Liège, started on 18 August 1789 and lasted until the destruction of the Republic of Liège and re-establishment of the Prince-Bishopric of Liège by Austrian forces in 1791.

zh.s: 1789年8月18日，反对列日执政主教的列日革命爆发，有时也称“幸运革命”（法语：Heureuse Révolution；瓦隆语：Binamêye revolucion）。革命持续至1791年奥地利军队摧毁列日共和国、恢复列日采邑主教国。

en.s: The action of 18 August 1798 was a minor naval engagement of the French Revolutionary Wars, fought between the British fourth rate ship HMS Leander and the French ship of the line Généreux. Both ships had been engaged at the Battle of the Nile three weeks earlier, in which a British fleet under Rear-Admiral Sir Horatio Nelson had destroyed a French fleet at Aboukir Bay on the Mediterranean coast of Egypt.

zh.s: 法国大革命战争期间，1798年8月18日，英国四级舰HMS Leander与法国战列舰Généreux发生小规模海战。三周前，两舰都参加了尼罗河战役；当时霍雷肖·纳尔逊爵士少将率领的英国舰队在埃及地中海沿岸的阿布基尔湾摧毁了法国舰队。

en.s: The Circassian ambush near Anapa was a military engagement between Circassians and the Russian Empire that occurred in 1809 near the strategic Anapa fortress, during the early stages of the Russo-Circassian War. According to an official Ottoman report, Circassian forces successfully ambushed and annihilated a large Russian detachment in a mountain gorge near Anapa.

zh.t: 阿纳帕附近的切尔克斯人伏击战
zh.s: 阿纳帕附近的切尔克斯人伏击战是1809年切尔克斯人与俄罗斯帝国之间的一次军事交战，发生在俄切战争初期，地点在具有战略意义的阿纳帕要塞附近。根据一份奥斯曼官方报告，切尔克斯军队在阿纳帕附近的山谷中成功伏击并歼灭了一支俄罗斯大部队。

en.t: The Senate of Finland is established in the Grand Duchy of Finland after the official adoption of the Statute of the Government Council by Tsar Alexander I of Russia
en.s: The Senate of Finland (Swedish: Senaten för Finland; Finnish: Suomen senaatti) combined the functions of cabinet and supreme court in the Grand Duchy of Finland and, from 1917, in independent Finland. It was established in 1809 as the Governing Council of the Grand Duchy of Finland (Regeringskonseljen för Storfurstendömet Finland), renamed the Imperial Senate of Finland (Kejserliga senaten för Finland) in 1816, and dissolved in 1918.

zh.t: 俄罗斯沙皇亚历山大一世正式采纳政府委员会章程后，芬兰大公国设立芬兰参议院
zh.s: 芬兰参议院（瑞典语：Senaten för Finland；芬兰语：Suomen senaatti）在芬兰大公国时期兼具内阁和最高法院职能，1917年芬兰独立后也继续履行这两项职能。该机构于1809年以芬兰大公国执政委员会之名设立，1816年更名为芬兰帝国参议院，1918年解散。

en.s: In the First Battle of Polotsk, which took place on 17–18 August 1812, Russian troops under the command of Peter Wittgenstein fought French and Bavarian troops led by Nicolas Oudinot near the city of Polotsk, halting Oudinot's advance toward Saint Petersburg once more as at the Battle of Klyastitsy. It was a strategic Russian success, but tactically the battle ended in a draw.

zh.s: 第一次波洛茨克战役于1812年8月17日至18日举行。彼得·维特根斯坦率领俄军在波洛茨克城附近与尼古拉·乌迪诺率领的法军和巴伐利亚军交战，再次阻止乌迪诺向圣彼得堡推进，情形与克利亚斯季齐战役相似。俄军在战略上取得成功，但战术上双方打成平手。

en.s: The Battle of Smolensk was the first major battle of the French invasion of Russia. It took place on 16–18 August 1812 and involved about 45,000 men of the Grande Armée under Emperor Napoleon I against about 30,000 Russian troops under General Barclay de Tolly. Napoleon occupied Smolensk by driving out Prince Pyotr Bagration's Second Army. The French artillery bombardment burned the city to the ground.

zh.s: 斯摩棱斯克战役是法国入侵俄罗斯期间的第一场大型战役，于1812年8月16日至18日进行。拿破仑一世率领约4.5万名大军团士兵，与巴克莱·德·托利将军率领的约3万名俄军交战。拿破仑击退彼得·巴格拉季昂亲王的第二集团军后占领斯摩棱斯克。法军炮击将这座城市夷为平地。

en.s: The Battle of Medina was fought approximately 20 miles south of San Antonio de Bexar (modern-day downtown San Antonio in the U.S. state of Texas) on August 18, 1813, as part of the Mexican War of Independence against Spanish authority in Mexico. Spanish troops led by General José Joaquín de Arredondo defeated republican forces (calling themselves the Republican Army of the North), consisting of Tejano-Mexican and Tejano-American revolutionaries participating in the Gutiérrez–Magee Expedition, under General José Álvarez de Toledo y Dubois.

zh.s: 1813年8月18日，墨西哥独立战争期间，支持西班牙统治的军队在德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥德贝哈尔（今圣安东尼奥市中心）以南约20英里处击败共和派军队。共和派自称北方共和军，由参加古铁雷斯—麦吉远征的泰哈诺—墨西哥和泰哈诺—美国革命者组成，由何塞·阿尔瓦雷斯·德·托莱多·杜布瓦将军率领。西班牙军队由何塞·华金·德·阿雷东多将军指挥。

en.s: The Platine War (18 August 1851 – 3 February 1852) was fought between the Argentine Confederation and an alliance consisting of the Empire of Brazil, Uruguay and the Argentine provinces of Entre Ríos and Corrientes. The war was part of a long-running contest between Argentina and Brazil for influence over Uruguay and Paraguay, and hegemony over the Platine region (areas bordering the Río de la Plata). The conflict took place in Uruguay, on the Río de la Plata, and northeastern Argentina. Uruguay's internal troubles, including the long-running Uruguayan Civil War, "La Guerra Grande" (The Great War), were heavily influential factors leading to the Platine War.

zh.s: 普拉塔战争于1851年8月18日至1852年2月3日进行，交战双方是阿根廷邦联与巴西帝国、乌拉圭以及阿根廷恩特雷里奥斯省和科连特斯省组成的联盟。这场战争是阿根廷与巴西长期争夺乌拉圭和巴拉圭影响力、以及普拉塔地区（拉普拉塔河沿岸地区）主导权的一部分。战事发生在乌拉圭、拉普拉塔河沿岸和阿根廷东北部。乌拉圭的内乱，包括长期持续的乌拉圭内战“大战争”（La Guerra Grande），是引发普拉塔战争的重要因素。

en.t: Attack at the Lower Sioux Agency
en.s: The Attack at the Lower Sioux Agency was the first organized attack led by Dakota leader Little Crow in Minnesota on August 18, 1862, and is considered the initial engagement of the Dakota War of 1862. It resulted in 13 settler deaths, and seven more killed while fleeing the agency for Fort Ridgely. Tensions had run high in the weeks leading up to the attack.

zh.s: 1862年8月18日，达科他族领袖小乌鸦在明尼苏达州领导了首次有组织的袭击，这被视为1862年达科他战争的开端。袭击造成13名定居者死亡，另有7人在逃往里奇利堡途中被杀。袭击发生前数周，双方关系已十分紧张。

en.s: The Battle of Redwood Ferry took place on August 18, 1862, on the first day of the Dakota War of 1862. A United States Army company responding to the Dakota attack at the Lower Sioux Agency from Fort Ridgeley was ambushed and defeated at Redwood Ferry.

loc: 美国弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡

en.s: The Battle of Globe Tavern, also known as the Second Battle of the Weldon Railroad, fought August 18–21, 1864, south of Petersburg, Virginia, was the second attempt of the Union Army to sever the Weldon Railroad during the Siege of Petersburg of the American Civil War. A Union force under Maj. Gen. Gouverneur K. Warren destroyed miles of track and withstood strong attacks from Confederate troops under Gen. P.G.T. Beauregard and Lt. Gen. A.P. Hill. It was the first Union victory in the Richmond-Petersburg Campaign. It forced the Confederates to carry their supplies 30 miles (48 km) by wagon to bypass the new Union lines that were extended farther to the south and west.

zh.s: 格洛布酒馆战役也称韦尔登铁路第二次战役，于1864年8月18日至21日在弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡以南进行。美国内战期间，联邦军第二次尝试切断韦尔登铁路，这是彼得斯堡围城战的一部分。古弗尼尔·K·沃伦少将率领的联邦军拆毁了数英里铁轨，并顶住了由P·G·T·博雷加德将军和A·P·希尔中将指挥的邦联军猛烈进攻。这是联邦军在里士满—彼得斯堡战役中的首场胜利。邦联军因此不得不把补给用马车运送30英里（48公里），绕开向南、向西延伸的新联邦军防线。

en.s: The Battle of Gravelotte (or Gravelotte–St. Privat) on 18 August 1870 was the largest battle during the Franco–Prussian War, named after Gravelotte, a village in Lorraine between Metz and the former French–German frontier. It was fought about 6 miles (9.7 km) west of Metz, where on the previous day, having intercepted the French army's retreat to the west at the Battle of Mars-La-Tour, the Prussians were now closing in to complete the destruction of the French forces. The combined German forces, under Field Marshal Count Helmuth von Moltke, were the Prussian First and Second Armies of the North German Confederation numbering about 210 infantry battalions, 133 cavalry squadrons, and 732 heavy cannons totaling 188,332 officers and men.

zh.s: 1870年8月18日，格拉沃洛特战役（也称格拉沃洛特—圣普里瓦战役）在普法战争期间爆发，是这场战争中规模最大的一场战役。战役以洛林的格拉沃洛特村命名，该村位于梅斯与当时法德边界之间。战场在梅斯以西约6英里（9.7公里）。前一天，普鲁士军队在马尔斯拉图尔战役中截断了法军向西撤退的路线；此时普军正逼近，企图彻底摧毁法军。赫尔穆特·冯·毛奇伯爵元帅指挥的德军联军由北德意志邦联的普鲁士第一、第二集团军组成，约有210个步兵营、133个骑兵中队和732门重炮，共188,332名军官和士兵。

en.t: American astronomer Asaph Hall discovers Phobos, one of Mars's moons
en.s: Asaph Hall III (October 15, 1829 – November 22, 1907) was an American astronomer who is best known for having discovered the two moons of Mars, Deimos and Phobos, in 1877. He determined the orbits of satellites of other planets and of double stars, the rotation of Saturn, and the mass of Mars.

zh.t: 美国天文学家阿萨夫·霍尔发现火卫一
zh.s: 阿萨夫·霍尔三世（1829年10月15日—1907年11月22日）是美国天文学家，以1877年发现火星的两颗卫星——火卫二和火卫一而闻名。他还测定了其他行星卫星和双星的轨道、土星的自转情况以及火星的质量。

en.s: Phobos () is the innermost and larger of the two natural satellites of Mars, the other being Deimos. The two moons were discovered in 1877 by American astronomer Asaph Hall. Phobos is named after the Greek god of fear and panic, who is the twin brother of Deimos and son of Ares (Mars). Phobos is a small, irregularly shaped object with a mean radius of 11 km (7 mi).

zh.s: 火卫一是火星两颗天然卫星中较靠近火星、体积也较大的一颗，另一颗是火卫二。这两颗卫星于1877年由美国天文学家阿萨夫·霍尔发现。火卫一的名称来自希腊恐惧与惊慌之神福波斯；他是戴莫斯的双胞胎兄弟，也是阿瑞斯（罗马名玛尔斯）的儿子。火卫一体积较小，形状不规则，平均半径为11公里（7英里）。

en.s: The Defense of Azakh took place between August 18, 1915 and November 21, 1915 and was one of the few remaining pockets of resistance during the Assyrian genocide that took place in Azakh (Syriac: ܐܙܟ, romanized: Azakh). en.s: The Battle of Langemarck (16–18 August 1917) was the second Anglo-French general attack of the Third Battle of Ypres, during the First World War. The battle took place near Ypres in Belgian Flanders, on the Western Front against the German 4th Army. The French First Army had a big success on the northern flank from Bixschoote to Drie Grachten (Three Canals) and the British gained a substantial amount of ground northwards from St Julien to the boundary with the French.

zh.s: 朗格马克战役（1917年8月16日至18日）是第一次世界大战期间第三次伊普尔战役中的第二次英法联合总攻。战斗发生在比利时佛兰德斯的伊普尔附近，西线交战方为德军第4集团军。法军第1集团军在比克斯斯霍特至德里·赫拉赫滕（“三条运河”）一线的北翼取得重大进展；英军则从圣朱利安向北推进，占领了大片地区，直至与法军接壤。

en.s: The Battle of Bobrek was an engagement that occurred in the town of Bobrek during the First Silesian Uprising on 18 August 1919. Insurgent forces under the command of Jan Trzęsiok captured the town of Bobrek, before declaring an establishment of a "Polish Republic". Ultimately however, insurgent forces had to withdraw from the town following a German counterattack.

zh.s: 1919年8月18日，第一次西里西亚起义期间，博布雷克镇发生战斗。扬·琴谢奥克率领的起义军占领博布雷克，随后宣布建立“波兰共和国”。不过，德国军队反攻后，起义军最终被迫撤出该镇。

en.s: The raid on Kronstadt (also known as Operation RK or the Scooter Raid) was an attack by Royal Navy coastal motor boats (CMBs) and Royal Air Force aircraft on the Bolshevik Baltic Fleet at its home base on 18 August 1919. After the Allied intervention in the Russian Civil War, Allied naval units operated in the Baltic Sea to support the independence of Estonia and Latvia, which were threatened by Bolshevik movements.

zh.s: 1919年8月18日，英国皇家海军沿岸摩托艇和皇家空军飞机袭击了驻扎在喀琅施塔得基地的布尔什维克波罗的海舰队。这次行动也称RK行动或“滑板车突袭”。协约国干预俄国内战后，协约国海军在波罗的海活动，支持爱沙尼亚和拉脱维亚独立，抵御布尔什维克势力的威胁。

en.s: the Battle of Godow (Polish: Bitwa pod Godowem) was a battle during the First Silesian Uprising that occurred on 18 August 1919 in the town of Godow, and resulted in a Polish victory. The battle was predated by an earlier attempted to capture the town by an insurgent company led by Maksymilian Iksal on August 17, which resulted in failure.

zh.s: 第一次西里西亚起义期间，戈多夫战役（波兰语：Bitwa pod Godowem）于1919年8月18日在戈多夫镇爆发，波兰一方获胜。此前一天，马克西米利安·伊克萨尔率领的起义军连队曾试图攻占该镇，但没有成功。

en.t: Nineteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Nineteenth Amendment (Amendment XIX) to the United States Constitution prohibits the United States and its states from denying the right to vote to citizens of the United States on the basis of sex, in effect recognizing the right of women to vote. The amendment was the culmination of a decades-long movement for women's suffrage in the United States, at both the state and national levels, and was part of the worldwide movement towards women's suffrage and part of the wider women's rights movement.
en.n: The Nineteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution is ratified, guaranteeing women's suffrage.

zh.t: 美国宪法第十九修正案
zh.s: 美国宪法第十九修正案（第XIX修正案）禁止美国联邦和各州以性别为由剥夺美国公民的投票权，实际上确认了女性的选举权。该修正案是美国持续数十年的妇女争取选举权运动的成果，运动同时在州和全国层面展开；它也是全球妇女争取选举权运动以及更广泛的妇女权利运动的一部分。
zh.n: 美国宪法第十九修正案获批准，保障女性选举权。

en.s: The IFA ( EE-fah), until 2004 the Internationale Funkausstellung Berlin ("International radio exhibition Berlin", a.k.a. "Berlin Radio Show", since 2025 as backronym Innovation for All), is one of the oldest industrial exhibitions in Germany. Between 1924 and 1939 it was an annual event, but from 1950 it was held every other year until 2005. Since then it has become an annual event again, held in September.

zh.s: IFA（读作EE-fah）在2004年前称为柏林国际广播展（Internationale Funkausstellung Berlin，意为“柏林国际广播展”，也称“柏林广播展”；自2025年起将IFA解释为“Innovation for All”）。它是德国历史最悠久的工业展览会之一。1924年至1939年间，该展会每年举办；1950年至2005年间则每两年举办一次。此后恢复为年度展会，并于每年9月举行。

en.s: On August 18, 1937, a lightning strike started the Blackwater Fire in Shoshone National Forest, approximately 35 miles (56 km) west of Cody, Wyoming, United States. Fifteen firefighters were killed by the forest fire when a dry weather front caused the winds to suddenly increase and change direction. The fire quickly spread into dense forest, creating spot fires that trapped some of the firefighters in a firestorm.

zh.s: 1937年8月18日，美国怀俄明州科迪以西约35英里（56公里）的肖松尼国家森林遭雷击，引发黑水山火。干燥天气锋面使风速突然增大并改变方向，导致15名消防员在山火中丧生。火势迅速蔓延至茂密森林，形成多处飞火，并将部分消防员困在火场中。

en.s: The Battle of Britain (German: Luftschlacht um England, lit. 'air battle for England') was a military campaign of the Second World War, in which the Royal Air Force (RAF) and the Fleet Air Arm (FAA) of the Royal Navy defended the United Kingdom against large-scale attacks by Nazi Germany's air force, the Luftwaffe. It was the first major military campaign fought entirely by air forces.
en.n: World War II: The Hardest Day air battle, part of the Battle of Britain, takes place. At that point, it is the largest aerial engagement in history with heavy losses sustained on both sides.

zh.s: 不列颠空战（德语：Luftschlacht um England，意为“英格兰空战”）是第二次世界大战期间的一场军事行动。英国皇家空军和皇家海军舰队航空兵抵御纳粹德国空军的大规模进攻。这是首次完全由空军进行的重大军事行动。

en.s: The Hardest Day was a Second World War air battle fought on 18 August 1940 during the Battle of Britain between the German Luftwaffe and British Royal Air Force (RAF). On that day, the Luftwaffe made an all-out effort to destroy RAF Fighter Command. The air battles that took place on that day were amongst the largest aerial engagements in history to that time.

zh.s: “最艰难的一天”是第二次世界大战期间不列颠空战中的一次空战，1940年8月18日由德国空军与英国皇家空军交战。当日，德国空军全力试图摧毁英国皇家空军战斗机司令部。当日发生的空战是当时历史上规模最大的空战之一。

en.s: The Battle of Mount Tambu was a series of actions fought in the Salamaua area of the Territory of New Guinea between Allied and Japanese forces, which took place between 16 July and 18 August 1943, during World War II. The battle formed part of the wider Salamaua–Lae campaign and was fought in the final stages of the campaign, which had seen a combined Australian and US force advance from Wau towards Salamaua following the repulse of the Japanese attack on Wau in late January and early February 1943.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，1943年7月16日至8月18日，新几内亚领地萨拉毛阿地区的盟军与日军进行了一系列战斗，这就是坦布山战役。战役属于更大规模的萨拉毛阿—莱城战役，是该战役最后阶段的一部分。1943年1月底至2月初，日军进攻瓦乌被击退后，澳大利亚和美国联军从瓦乌向萨拉毛阿推进。

en.s: Operation Hydra was a Royal Air Force attack on the Peenemünde Army Research Center on the night of 17/18 August 1943. It was the first time a master bomber was used for the main force. Group Captain John Searby, CO of 83 Squadron, commanded the operation. It began the Operation Crossbow strategic bombing campaign against Nazi Germany's V-weapon programme.

zh.s: 海德拉行动是英国皇家空军于1943年8月17日至18日夜间对佩内明德陆军研究中心发动的空袭。这是主轰炸机首次用于指挥主力部队。第83中队指挥官约翰·瑟比大队长负责指挥此次行动。该行动开启了针对纳粹德国V武器计划的“弩”行动战略轰炸行动。

en.s: Operation Kutuzov was the first of the two counteroffensives launched by the Red Army as part of the Kursk Strategic Offensive Operation. en.s: The Battle off Horaniu (Japanese: 第一次ベララベラ海戦) was a minor naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, fought near Vella Lavella in the Solomon Islands. en.s: A general election was held in the Northern Territory, Australia, on 18 August 2001. The centre-left Australian Labor Party (ALP), led by Clare Martin, won a surprising victory over the Country Liberal Party (CLP). Before this, the CLP had held 18 out the 25 seats in the Northern Territory Legislative Assembly to the ALP's 7. After this election, the ALP held the majority with 13 seats to the CLP's 10, consigning the CLP to opposition for the first time since the Territory gained responsible government. Martin became Chief Minister, succeeding the CLP's Denis Burke.

en.s: The Battle of Chegem was an armed confrontation between Russian security forces and militants from the Yarmuk Jamaat, an Islamist insurgent group operating in the North Caucasus. en.s: The Uzbin Valley ambush occurred when ISAF troops were ambushed by Afghan militants in eastern Afghanistan on 18 August 2008. It took place outside the village of Spēṟ Kunday, of the Surobi District of Kabul province and resulted in heavy casualties to the French ISAF contingent. A NATO report of the incident summarised that the surviving members of the Coalition forces were "lucky to escape" arguing that they were poorly equipped, ill-organised and faced a well-prepared enemy. However, this version was denied by the French government. Later reports claimed that until then the relative calm of the region had only been obtained by bribery, of which the French were unaware.

en.s: On August 18, 2011, a series of cross-border attacks with parallel attacks and mutual cover was carried out in southern Israel on Highway 12 near the Egyptian border by a squad of presumably 12 militants in four groups. The attacks occurred after Israel's interior security service Shin Bet had warned of an attack by militants in the region and Israeli troops had been stationed in the area. The militants first opened fire at an Egged No. 392 bus as it was traveling on Highway 12 in the Negev near Eilat. Several minutes later, a bomb was detonated next to an Israeli army patrol along Israel's border with Egypt.

en.s: The 2019 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Croke Park in Dublin on 18 August 2019 between Kilkenny and Tipperary, the culmination of the 2019 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship. It was the 132nd final of that sport's primary competition, the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship. Tipperary defeated Kilkenny to claim their 28th All-Ireland title.

zh.s: 2019年全爱尔兰高级板棍球锦标赛决赛于2019年8月18日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，由基尔肯尼对阵蒂珀雷里。这是该项主要赛事的第132届决赛，也是2019年锦标赛的收官之战。蒂珀雷里击败基尔肯尼，夺得队史第28个全爱尔兰冠军。

en.s: On 18 August 2020, elements of the Malian Armed Forces began a mutiny, and subsequently undertook a coup d'état. Soldiers on pick-up trucks stormed the Soundiata military base in the town of Kati, where gunfire was exchanged before weapons were distributed from the armory and senior officers arrested. Tanks and armoured vehicles were seen on the town's streets, as well as military trucks heading for the capital, Bamako.

en.s: The 2020 Volusia County Chair election was held on November 3, 2020, following a primary election on August 18, 2020, to elect the Volusia County Chair. Incumbent County Chair Ed Kelley, who was first elected in 2016, initially announced that he would seek re-election, but ultimately declined to seek re-election to a second term. Three candidates ran to succeed Kelley: County Councilwoman Deb Denys, farmer Jeff Brower, and retiree Gerard Witman.

en.s: On August 18, 2021, jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin ambushed a convoy of Burkinabe soldiers and civilians near Boukouma, Séno Province, Burkina Faso. en.s: A by-election was held on August 18, 2025, to elect a member of Parliament (MP) to represent Battle River—Crowfoot, Alberta, in the House of Commons for the remainder of the 45th Parliament following the resignation of Conservative Party MP Damien Kurek. en.s: The 2026 St. Petersburg mayoral election took place on August 18, 2026, with a runoff election scheduled to be held on November 3, 2026. Welch and his main challenger, former Florida governor Charlie Crist, advanced to the runoff election after no candidate received a majority of the vote.

zh.t: 2026年佛罗里达州圣彼得堡市长选举
zh.s: 2026年圣彼得堡市长选举于2026年8月18日举行，第二轮投票定于11月3日举行。现任市长肯·韦尔奇于2021年首次当选，此次寻求连任。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，韦尔奇和主要挑战者、佛罗里达州前州长查理·克里斯特进入第二轮投票。
